The cost of AI—and the devices needed to use it

We examine the cost of intelligence using token prices grouped into tiers against Africa's economic position, and the price of the devices people actually buy.

13 model prices and 13 device records, updated daily.

Compare access by country and model

Choose a country and a model. Workload prices, monthly subscriptions, official location listings, and payment evidence are separate measures, with their coverage shown separately.

API list price

Standard workload

$22.50

1,000,000 input tokens + 250,000 output tokens · API list price for Claude Fable 5.1 (Anthropic).

In Ghana, this workload equals 10.27% of monthly GNI per capita (a national average).

API prices are held for 13 models; this model’s GNI-based comparison covers 52 of 54 countries.

How people actually reach a model

A model with a fine price that cannot be paid for is priced at infinity. This layer records subscriptions, free tiers and whether a locally issued card is accepted. Evidence is labelled: "tested" only where a check was performed and dated, otherwise provider documents or reported, and "unclear" wherever no source states the fact.

6 of 60provider and country pairs payable with a locally issued card
2documented as not payable that way
52unclear, and counted rather than assumed
29products with a free tier

Charts and evidence

Read the published charts below, or make your own chart from selected records.

How this record is kept

The standard workload

Input plus a quarter of output, a defined unit rather than an average bill. Prices are list rates from provider documentation or reporting. A rate card is not a cost: a model that finishes a task in fewer steps can cost less than a cheaper model.

Capability

Scores come from the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. The index was restated in September 2026, so launch-era scores are not comparable with current ones. Each row carries its basis.

Known gaps

The official location lists cover 6 provider-product lists; they describe geographic listing, not signup, local payment, feature-tier access or uptime. A GNI-based workload comparison has values for 52 of 54 countries. The separate minimum-wage comparison covers 8 countries in its declared sample. African providers and locally hosted inference are not yet priced. Device records measure reported changes, not an African price index.
